direct_effect_checks.basis: Independent arithmetic over recorded before/after decision observations, in addition to the existing probe checks. Counts include the fixed-policy cohort.

limitations: All mechanics and terminal control choices are labelled diagnostics, never demonstrations or training inputs. Offline policy-support scores do not make their scripted actions policy-sampled.
The two fixed-random-weight ordinary games reached collection cutoffs, not natural outcomes. Natural victory/defeat was established by the separate controlled town-capture diagnostics in both colors.
The 287 recorded native acknowledgements are all accepted. Invalid action probes rejected before send do not establish rejected native acknowledgements.

No fully transient enemy sighting interval is exercised in this cohort; ten intermediate enemy-position samples are present. Fog evidence combines owned-view checks, callback source review and native replay, not a universal leak proof.
Closed-window and stack-popup observations omit private parent rows, but this cohort does not exercise an independently changing private parent army while that window is closed.
No live coverage is claimed for unaffordable upgrades, multiple upgrade choices, full-capacity garrison consolidation rejection, hero-cap garrison rejection, or Scholar-triggered hero exchange.
The ordinary fixed-weight policy did not naturally hire a hero, upgrade a stack, or reach a natural outcome. It did sample native split, merge, swap and garrison operations.
Semantic tamper report review covers 208 detected mutations in eight completed suites; their positive controls overlap the 18 original-game native replays and do not add games.

preserved_failure.reason: The diagnostic buy helper incorrectly sent back after successful native creature recruitment had already returned to town overview. Fixed before mechanics-2; the original failed capture remains retained.

scope: Independent read-only inspection, source and artifact hashing, fresh history audits, direct recorded-slot arithmetic, and exact fixed-weight replay of saved policy decisions. No game or training launched by this audit.

semantic_tamper_report_review.scope: Read-only review of completed report results and positive-control native replay checks; tamper executions were performed by the parent. Positive controls overlap original-game replay coverage and are not additional games.
